setup.zh: 天快亮时，窗纸响了三下：隔壁的{伴}塞进来一个还温着的煮鸡蛋。
setup.en: Near dawn the window paper taps three times: {伴} from next door pushes in a boiled egg, still warm.

recap.zh: 天亮前，{伴}隔着窗塞来一个煮鸡蛋。
recap.en: Before dawn {伴} pushed a boiled egg through the window.

en: Near dawn, three taps on the window paper.

story.zh:
天快亮的时候，窗纸上响了三下。你爬起来，推开窗——是隔壁的{伴}，冻得鼻子通红，往你手里塞了一个还温着的煮鸡蛋。

「我娘说你们要去黑松岭，」{伴}压低声音，「……你别死在里头啊。」

「死不了。」
story.en:
Near dawn there are three taps on the window paper. You get up and push the window open — it is {伴} from next door, nose red with cold, pushing a boiled egg, still warm, into your hand.

"My mum says you're going to Black Pine Ridge," {伴} whispers. "…Don't go and die in there."

"I won't."

what.zh: 天没亮，隔着窗塞给你一个煮鸡蛋：「记账，以后还我。」
what.en: Before dawn, pushed a boiled egg through your window: "Keep count. Pay me back."

story.zh: 「那记账，」{伴}把手缩回袖子里，「一个鸡蛋，以后还我。」
story.en: "Then keep count," says {伴}, pulling the hand back into the sleeve. "One egg. You pay me back."

label.en: Push it back: your family owes rent too

exits.means: refuses the egg, gives it back

story.zh:
你把鸡蛋推了回去：「你家也欠着租。」

{伴}瞪了你一眼，缩回手，关窗前丢下一句：「那你活着回来。回来了，我再给你。」
story.en:
You push the egg back. "Your family owes rent too."

{伴} glares at you and pulls the hand back, and says one thing before the window closes: "Then come back alive. Come back, and I'll give it to you then."
